# Pixel Agents & Agent Forge Development Reference

Pixel Agents is an AI agent marketplace where users deploy specialized agents for one-shot tasks. Agent Forge is the visual builder that lets users create custom agents with AI-generated portraits. Both run on Azure Static Web Apps with Azure Functions APIs.

## Recent Changes

_Changelog maintained by CEO. Agents should read this first — it reflects the most recent state of Pixel Agents and may contradict older sections below. The sync script pulls this section to the top of every injected skill block. Entries older than 30 days get condensed into the main skill body._

**2026-06-11 — Codex audit: billing is coded but NOT enforced at run time**

Full-product audit (see `ambientpixels/docs/system-codex/`). Stripe products (pa-pro monthly/yearly + pa-credit-10/50), checkout, billing webhook, and the entire Stripe Connect creator payout system are implemented. But `pixel-agent-run` only checks flat rate limits (5 anon / 25 auth per day) and **never consults entitlements** — so `paUnlimitedRuns`, `paPriorityQueue`, and purchased credits are dead flags: a paying Pro user gets exactly what a free user gets. Also: `FREE_DEFAULTS.dailyLimit: 3` in entitlements contradicts `RATE_LIMIT_AUTH: 25` in pixel-agent-run. Activation checklist: (1) entitlements lookup + credit consumption in pixel-agent-run, (2) reconcile the 3-vs-25 limit, (3) frontend remaining-runs display + upsell CTAs. Payout math (documented here for the first time): $0.02/run base, 40% of Pro revenue forms the monthly creator pool, free creators keep 50% / Pro creators 70% of their run share with 1.5x run weight, $25 minimum payout (rolls over), auto-run 1st of month 06:00 UTC. **Do not market creator revenue share until run-level billing enforcement exists** — payouts could exceed revenue.

**2026-04-19 — Premium redesign + commit to dark-only**
- Full-surface editorial redesign: violet `#8F00FF` primary → Signal Red `#E3442C`, near-black `#0A0A0C` neutral, warm paper `#F4F1EA` ink, radii tightened 6/10/16 → 2/4/4, grain via `mix-blend-mode: overlay` at 0.08
- Typography: Space Grotesk display (kept), Manrope body (kept), **Fraunces italic** added as `--pa-font-accent` with `font-variation-settings: "opsz" 144, "SOFT" 50` on manifesto title accent. Instrument Serif and Architect's Daughter were considered and rejected (overused / scrapbook respectively)
- New `.pa-hero-v3` on landing — agent-led split (headline + 4:5 portrait, smooth gradient spotlight, no portrait-as-atmosphere image — dropped after testing)
- New `.pa-manifesto` editorial closing beat site-wide (9 pages: 8 pixel-agents + agent-forge), sig "— First Principle"
- New `.pa-btn-editorial` — paper-fill + ink-text button for highest-weight conversion (manifesto CTA, sidebar "New Agent"). NOT an override of `.pa-btn-primary`.
- `.pa-hero-v2`, `.pa-spotlight` main section, `.pa-terminal-section` ("Build Your Own Agent") removed. Manifesto absorbs the build-your-own CTA role.
- Retired tokens: `--pa-secondary` (cyan) and `--pa-tertiary` (magenta) — all 35 call sites migrated to `--pa-accent` (amber `#E8A33A`). Tier rarity colors unchanged (gold/purple/blue/green).
- Pre-blurred portrait assets (`-bg.webp`) pipeline + `scripts/generate-portrait-bg.js` (sharp-based). Currently unused at runtime — hero uses gradient spotlight — but pipeline is wired for future use.
- Featured agent curation: 13 → 6 featured (one per category, mix of tiers). Featured is an editorial badge, NOT a sort key — default sort uses curator-set `order` field.
- Light theme REMOVED — Pixel Agents is dark-native. Legacy `body[data-theme="light"]` rules in some CSS files are inert dead code (no toggle to activate them). `--pa-portrait-frame` token (fixed dark) is kept as a safety net.
- Palette customization (6-preset picker in avatar dropdown) REMOVED. Signal Red is non-negotiable — brand identity, not a preference. If a user asks for theme/color customization, push back: "the product has an opinionated aesthetic; we don't paint over it."
- Sidebar logo: `fa-diagram-project` icon + horizontal wordmark (was stacked text-only)
- Topbar wordmarks differentiated per page (Explore / Run / Docs / FAQ / Upgrade / Contact / Changelog / Activity / Agent Forge) — was duplicating "Pixel Agents" brand on index/run

## Quick Orientation

**Pixel Agents Frontend:** `ambientpixels/pixel-agents/` — catalog, run, analytics pages
**Agent Forge Frontend:** `ambientpixels/agent-forge/` — visual card pipeline builder
**APIs:** `ambientpixels/api/pixel-agent-*` + `agentforge-*` — 20 Azure Function endpoints
**Agent Registry:** `ambientpixels/pixel-agents/data/pixel-agents.json` + `ambientpixels/api/_data/pixel-agents.json` (MUST stay in sync)
**AI Models:** Claude Sonnet 4.6 (text analysis) + Gemini 2.5 Flash (image generation)
**Portrait Scripts:** `ambientpixels/scripts/generate-agent-portraits.js` + `generate-ambientos-portraits.js`

## Architecture Overview

```
Pixel Agents Catalog (/pixel-agents/)
├── index.html — agent card grid with source tabs + category filters + sort + trending
├── run.html — individual agent execution page (tier-aware redesign + share card button)
├── analytics.html — creator analytics + payout dashboard
├── docs.html — documentation (agent building, output types, rate limits, revenue share)
├── faq.html — FAQ with <details>/<summary> accordion
├── changelog.html — version history timeline
├── contact.html — contact form (hooks into formIntake API)
├── js/pixel-agents-ui.js — catalog logic, spotlight, carousel, filters, grid, trending
├── js/pixel-agent-run.js — agent execution, result rendering, share cards
├── js/pixel-agent-analytics.js — analytics + payout status + leaderboard + history
├── css/pixel-agents-design-system.css — design tokens + scoped resets
├── css/pixel-agents-layout.css — app shell grid + responsive + sidebar resources
├── css/pixel-agents-components.css — hero, spotlight, carousel, cards, badges, trending
├── css/pixel-agent-run.css — run page styles + share modal
├── css/pixel-agent-analytics.css — analytics + earnings + leaderboard + payout styles
├── css/pixel-agent-card.css — agent card component
├── img/ — 24 Arcane-style agent portraits (1024x1024 PNG)
└── data/pixel-agents.json — agent registry (frontend copy)

Agent Forge (/agent-forge/)
├── index.html — 3-column builder (tray, pipeline canvas, preview)
├── js/agent-forge.js — builder logic, drag-and-drop, state, portrait generator, edit mode
└── css/agent-forge.css — builder styles (fully token-migrated)

Azure Functions API (20 endpoints)
├── pixel-agent-run — Execute agent (Claude + optional Gemini/search/fetch) + creator attribution
├── pixel-agent-catalog — List agents with usage stats + 7-day trending (recentStats)
├── pixel-agent-review — AI gatekeeper (quality/uniqueness/safety scoring)
├── pixel-agent-submit — Save submission + trigger review + auto-approve (cap: 5)
├── pixel-agent-community — List approved community agents
├── pixel-agent-approve — CEO approve/reject (handles edits, cap: 5)
├── pixel-agent-remove — Delete community agent
├── pixel-agent-analytics — Creator stats + earnings + leaderboard + payout history
├── pixel-agent-checkout — Stripe checkout session
├── pixel-agent-billing-webhook — Stripe webhook handler
├── pixel-agent-entitlements — Query user billing status
├── pixel-agent-share-card — Server-side OG image generation (satori + resvg, 1200x630 PNG)
├── pixel-agent-share — HTML page with OG meta tags for social unfurling
├── pixel-agent-creator-onboard — Stripe Connect Express account creation + onboarding URL
├── pixel-agent-creator-status — Creator's Connect enrollment + payout readiness
├── pixel-agent-connect-webhook — Stripe Connect webhooks (account.updated, transfer.failed)
├── pixel-agent-payout-run — CEO manual payout trigger (dry-run or execute)
├── pixel-agent-payout-timer — Monthly auto-payout (6 AM UTC, 1st of month)
├── pixel-agent-payout-admin — CEO admin view (all creators, all payout runs, dry-run/execute)
├── agentforge-drafts — Per-user draft CRUD (blob storage)
├── agentforge-portrait — AI portrait generation (Gemini)
├── pixel-agent-run/smoke-test.js — 22 automated tests
└── _data/pixel-agents.json — agent registry (API copy)

Stripe Libraries (api/_lib/stripe/)
├── stripeClient.js — Core Stripe API client (raw axios, no SDK)
├── productCatalog.js — 8 products (PA Pro monthly/yearly, credits, CF/SF Pro)
├── entitlements.js — Per-user entitlements at billing/entitlements/{userId}.json
├── stripeConnect.js — Connect Express API (createAccount, accountLink, transfer, balance)
├── creatorProfiles.js — Creator profile CRUD via companyStorage
├── payoutCalculation.js — Snapshot delta, Pro subscriber scan, pool math, weighted distribution
└── payoutExecutor.js — Full payout execution flow (idempotency, balance check, transfers)
```

## Agent Registry (24 built-in + community agents)

Agents are defined in JSON:
```json
{
  "id": "agent-id",
  "name": "Display Name",
  "tagline": "Short description",
  "category": "tools|audit|design|...",
  "tier": "common|uncommon|rare|epic|legendary",
  "icon": "fas fa-icon-name",
  "capabilities": ["Cap 1", "Cap 2"],
  "inputType": "textarea|url",
  "inputValidation": "text|url",
  "systemPrompt": "You are...",
  "userPromptTemplate": "Do this: {{input}}",
  "outputSections": [{ "key": "score", "label": "Score", "type": "score" }],
  "generationConfig": { "temperature": 0.8, "maxOutputTokens": 1500 }
}
```

### Special Agent Flags
- `"webSearch": true` — calls Brave Search API before Claude
- `"fetchUrl": true` — fetches actual page HTML for URL inputs
- `"imageGeneration": true` — after Claude analysis, calls Gemini to generate image
- `"rateLimitCost": 2` — image agents cost 2 runs

### Output Section Types
score, verdict, text, list, tags, highlight, image, color_palette, name_list

## Agent Categories (12)
audit, content, strategy, naming, pitch, design, lifestyle, tools, career, intel, gaming, creative

## Rate Limits

| Limit | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Agent runs (anonymous) | 5/day per IP |
| Agent runs (authenticated) | 25/day per userId |
| Agent submissions | 5/day |
| Portrait generation | 10/day per user |
| Live agent cap | 5 per user |

Rate limit keys: anonymous uses IP hash (`ipHash_YYYY-MM-DD`), authenticated uses userId (`userId_YYYY-MM-DD`). Separate buckets — logging in resets allowance. CEO (`x-company-secret: pixelpusher`) bypasses all limits.

## API Execution Flow (pixel-agent-run)

```
Request → Validate agent → Extract user identity (cfAuth) → Rate limit check →
  → [if webSearch] Brave Search API →
  → [if fetchUrl] Fetch page HTML, strip to text →
  → Build prompt (template + search + site context) →
  → Call Claude API (claude-sonnet-4-6) →
  → Parse JSON response →
  → [if imageGeneration] Call Gemini via imageEngine →
  → Store run record (with userId + creatorId) → Update stats + creatorStats → Return result
```

## Auto-Approve System

When agents are submitted:
1. AI gatekeeper scores quality, uniqueness, safety (0-100 each)
2. All scores >= 70 → **auto-approved**, goes live immediately
3. Any score < 70 → forwarded to CEO approval queue
4. Any score < 40 → rejected outright

## Edit Gates (Live Agent Editing)

Click edit (pen icon) on live agents in sidebar → loads config into builder.

**Can change freely (no review):** tagline, description, icon, portrait, tier, temperature, max tokens
**Locked (disabled in edit mode):** name, category, system prompt, user prompt template, input type, output sections, powers

Cosmetic-only changes apply instantly. Name and agent ID are immutable after approval.

## Portrait Generator

Endpoint: `POST /api/agentforge-portrait`

Two modes via `mode` parameter:

### Agent Portraits (`mode: 'agent'` — default)
Style locked to Arcane League of Legends. Selectors:
- **Archetype**: Scholar, Operative, Executive, Creative, Technician, Mystic, Rebel, Guardian
- **Expression**: Confident, Intense, Friendly, Mysterious, Fierce, Calm
- **Appearance**: Masculine, Feminine, Androgynous, Non-human
- **Age**: Young (20s), Mid (30s), Mature (40s), Elder (50s+)
- **Color Accent**: None, Blue, Purple, Gold, Red, Green, Teal, Silver

### Creator Avatars (`mode: 'avatar'`)
Simple flat cartoon illustration style (distinct from agent portraits). Selectors:
- **Appearance**: Masculine, Feminine, Androgynous
- **Expression**: Confident, Friendly, Calm, Intense, Mysterious
- **Age**: Young, Mid, Mature, Elder
- **Style** (`avatarStyle`): Casual, Professional, Creative, Techy, Formal
- **Color Accent**: None, Blue, Purple, Gold, Teal, Silver

Avatar mode skips archetypes (no suits/armor), uses casual clothing by default. Output centered on face for circular crop.

All portraits uploaded to blob as WebP (community agents + avatars). Built-in agent portraits served from `/pixel-agents/img/{id}.webp`.

## Community Agent Discovery

Catalog page has three filter layers:
1. **Source tabs**: All / Built-in / Community (cyan accent)
2. **Category tabs**: All / Audit / Content / ... (purple accent)
3. **Sort dropdown**: Featured / Trending / Most Runs / Newest / Name A-Z

Community tab auto-switches to "Newest" sort. Empty state links to Agent Forge.

## Trending System

- Catalog API returns `recentStats` (7-day per-agent run counts from `pixelAgentRuns`)
- Cards show fire badge when 7-day runs >= 5
- "Trending" sort option orders by 7-day activity
- Spotlight widgets include dynamic "Trending Agents" widget (top 3 this week)

## Agent of the Day

- Deterministic daily spotlight rotation: `spotlightIndex = dayOfYear % spotlightAgents.length`
- Badge: "Agent of the Day" (replaces "Featured Prototype")
- Section label: "Daily Spotlight / Agent of the Day"
- Timer rotation still works after initial daily pick

## Shareable Result Cards

- `POST /api/pixel-agent-share-card?run=RUNID` — generates 1200x630 PNG via satori + @resvg/resvg-js
- `GET /api/pixel-agent-share?run=RUNID` — returns HTML with OG meta tags for social unfurling
- OG image auto-shows agent name, tier, score, verdict
- Share Card button on run.html result actions
- Font: SpaceGrotesk-Bold.ttf bundled in share-card endpoint directory

## Creator Analytics (/pixel-agents/analytics.html)

- Auth-gated page at Activity nav link
- Fetches `GET /api/pixel-agent-analytics`
- Shows: summary cards (live agents, total runs, 7-day runs, pending count)
- Revenue Share Estimate card (total + 7-day earnings, "Preview" badge)
- Stripe Connect status card (enrollment state, pending balance, "Payouts Active" badge)
- Per-agent cards: portrait, name, total runs, 7-day runs, last run, est. earnings
- Creator Leaderboard: ranked by runs, medal badges, tier indicator (Free 1x / Pro 1.5x)
- Next Payout estimate: amount, date, share %, weight, $25 minimum warning
- Pro Upgrade CTA: "Earn 70% instead of 50%, 1.5x weight, unlimited agents — $12/mo"
- Payout History table: month, amount, status, transfer ID with copy button
- Pending agents section with "Pending Review" badges
- Empty state with Agent Forge CTA

## Run Page Design

- Tier-aware gradient header (legendary=gold, epic=purple, etc.)
- Input section wrapped in card surface
- Two-column result grid on desktop (900px+), score card full-width
- Staggered fadeInUp animation on result cards
- Agent portrait in loading state
- Related Agents section: 3 same-category agents (fills with others if < 3)

## Design System (premium editorial, dark-native)

**Brand identity is non-negotiable.** Pixel Agents is the dark editorial AI agent marketplace. Signal Red is the product's voice — we don't let users repaint it. No light theme, no palette picker. If a user asks for theme customization, push back.

All tokens in `pixel-agents-design-system.css`, scoped under `body.pa-shell`:


# StoryForge — Development Skill

StoryForge is an AI-powered interactive fiction game at `ambientpixels/storyforge/`. Players pick a genre, create a character via a 3-step wizard, then play through branching narratives with skill checks, inventory, companions, and AI-generated scene art + narration.

For deep architectural details, module internals, and API specs, read `ambientpixels/storyforge/docs/SYSTEM.md`.

## Recent Changes

_Changelog maintained by CEO. Agents should read this first — it reflects the most recent state of StoryForge and may contradict older sections below. The sync script pulls this section to the top of every injected skill block. Entries older than 30 days get condensed into the main skill body._

### 2026-06-11 — Codex audit: monetization enforcement gaps

Full-product audit (see `ambientpixels/docs/system-codex/`). Stripe is LIVE (sf-pro monthly $9.99/yearly, checkout + webhook working). Enforced correctly: Pro genre locks and save-slot limits (server-side 403). Two revenue leaks to fix before paid acquisition:
1. **Daily free limit (3 adventures/day) is client-side only** — tracked in localStorage `storyforge-ai-usage`; clearing it resets the cap. Each free adventure costs ~$0.03–0.05 in Gemini calls. Move the counter server-side (entitlements record).
2. ~~Entitlements treat authenticated ≈ pro~~ — **verified FALSE 2026-06-11**: `/api/storyforge-entitlements` is correct. Authenticated non-admin users get their real Stripe record; Pro values key off `hasActiveSubscription` which requires `tier='pro' && subscriptionStatus='active'` (`_lib/stripe/entitlements.js:isProActive`). Only the `isAdminUser` branch returns unconditional Pro.
Also: 6 genres live (3 free / 3 Pro) — older "7 genres" references are wrong. Whole AI stack is single-provider Gemini (story `2.5-flash`, images `2.5-flash-image`, TTS `2.5-flash-preview-tts` — a preview model that may change). No per-user AI cost tracking exists.

- **2026-04-24 — Graphic-novel design system overhaul shipped (commit `d5a2af432`)**
  - **NEW file**: `css/adventure-theme.css` (~3,000 lines) is the entire design system. Loads after `adventure-base.css`, before `adventure-responsive.css`. Re-declares all `--sf-*` tokens at `:root` (warm-near-black `#1A1410` page, cream `#F2E8D5` captions, hazard-orange `#EF8A1F` accent). Touch THIS file for any visual changes; `adventure-base.css` is now a fallback only.
  - **DO NOT use raw hex `#1A1410`** — it equals both `--sf-bg-page` AND `--sf-border-heavy`. Borders on dark surfaces using `--sf-border-heavy` go invisible. Use `#000` for borders on dark page.
  - **Cascade order matters**: any new rule overriding a `.adv-*` styling needs to live BELOW the `PR7-FINAL` block in `adventure-theme.css` (last ~600 lines). Earlier sections lose to later sections of same file.
  - **New asset dirs**: `images/assets/paper-tile.png`, `images/heroes/hub-hero.png`, `images/genre-cards/genre-*.png` (7 painterly comic-style cards). Old `images/genre-*.webp` retained for rollback.
  - **Genre colors retuned** to warm-family in BOTH `data/genres.json` (`color` field) AND `css/adventure-effects.css` (`--sf-accent` overrides). If you change one, change both.
  - **Hand-drawn borders** via inline SVG `feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap` data-URIs. Pattern lives on hero panel, caption box, and CTA button. Tunable via `inset`, `stroke-width`, `scale` (turbulence displacement).
  - **Wizard step 2 (Customize Character)** is **cream-mode** (`bg: var(--sf-bg-caption)` + paper tile) on desktop; mobile falls back to dark. Step 3 (Stats) same.
  - **Form grid**: `.adv-char-creator__field-grid` wraps Name + `#charOptionsContainer` and uses `display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr`. Options container uses `display: contents` so its 5 dropdown children flatten into the parent grid alongside Name = balanced 2x3.
  - **Name input `#playerNameInput`** moved from step 1 → step 2. ID unchanged. Random name fallback via `window.AdventureRPG.generateName()` (the global is `AdventureRPG`, NOT `RPG` — `RPG` is a local alias inside the engine IIFE).
  - **Stats portrait** mirrors via inline `<script>` in `play.html` using `MutationObserver` on `#portraitImage` src. No engine touch.
  - **Radar canvas** is `<canvas width="240" height="280">` — the 280 height is necessary for the bottom INT label/value to render inside the pixel buffer. Don't shrink to 240.
  - **State-aware budget pill** classes: `.adv-stat-allocator__budget--low` (1-4 left, gold), `--empty` (exactly 0, green), `--over` (negative, red). Toggled by `updateStatBudgetDisplay()` in engine.
  - **Hub copy**: drop "AI-Powered" framing (per brand voice). Hub feature cards hidden via `.adv-hub > .adv-hub__features { display: none }`.
  - **Cache version**: bumped to `?v=20260424n`. Bump letter when any CSS/JS changes; ALL THREE HTML files in the same commit.

- **2026-04-25 — `play.html` polish session shipped (cache `?v=20260425r`)**
  Wide-ranging polish iteration over the in-story state. Began as a 6-fix spec (sidebar/HP/portrait/Pause/loading), expanded to address layout, choice cards, inventory, location pill, and a full genre palette overhaul. Final state below.

  **Loading state — interactive halftone-print spotlight** (after iterating through halftone bloom → border-radius blobs → SVG ink splats — all rejected as "not landing"):
  - **Final design**: cream parchment surface (paper-tile bg) covering the entire `.adv-scene__image-placeholder`, with a dim warm-grey dot field (`.adv-halftone-print__field`) and a cursor-following accent-color "spotlight" (`.adv-halftone-print__spotlight`).
  - **Mouse follow**: inline `<script>` in [play.html](../../../ambientpixels/storyforge/play.html) updates `--cursor-x` / `--cursor-y` CSS custom properties on mousemove. Spotlight is a `mask-image: radial-gradient(circle var(--spot-radius) at var(--cursor-x) var(--cursor-y), …)` over the accent-dot grid. Soft falloff: `rgba(0,0,0,0.85) 0% → 0.45 50% → 0 100%`, opacity `0.75` overall, radius `220px`.
  - **Idle drift**: when mouse leaves or is idle >1.5s, a `requestAnimationFrame` Lissajous figure-8 (12s × 17s amplitudes, 70% panel coverage) drives the spotlight so the screen always has motion. Resumes mouse-follow on next mousemove.
  - **Critical pointer-events fix**: `.adv-scene__image` (z-5, opacity:0 until loaded) was catching every mousemove and blocking the spotlight handler. Override `pointer-events: none` on the image — it's display-only.
  - **Caption box**: cream `--sf-bg-caption-alt` (slightly darker than parchment) so it stamps onto the page; rotating loading text via the existing `LOADING_MESSAGES` cycle.
  - **`cursor: crosshair`** on the placeholder so the user has a visual cue they can interact.

  **Engine.js touches** (loading + HP only — engine still off-limits for unrelated work):
  - `GENRE_LOADING_MESSAGES` (per-genre × 5 messages each) collapsed to a single `LOADING_MESSAGES` array of 4 comic-themed messages: `'Inking the scene…'`, `'Drawing the panel…'`, `'Setting the moment…'`, `'Forging your story…'`. 2s cycle (was 2.5s).
  - Both `UI.showLoading(UI.$('sceneText'), 'Forging your story...')` calls replaced with `UI.$('sceneText').innerHTML = ''` so only ONE loading message is on screen at a time.
  - HP thresholds: `<30%` danger / `<=60%` warning (was `<=25%` / `<=50%`).

  **New token `--sf-accent-chrome` (`#EF8A1F`)** — non-genre-tinted warm orange. **Use this for anything that should stay warm regardless of genre** (sidebar headers, Dossier label, level badge, Pause pill, fullscreen-button hover). `--sf-accent` is genre-tinted via `[data-genre]` cascade — cool on sci-fi/superhero/pirate/fantasy/detective, warm on horror/post-apoc. Anything chrome-y wired to `--sf-accent` will go cool on those genres. The chrome token bypasses the cascade.

  **Layout + composition:**
  - **Scene caption** max-width `38rem` → `45rem` (~720px) so the reading column doesn't shrink dramatically below the wide scene image.
  - **Choice cards** desktop gap `1rem` → `1.75rem` (~28px). Mobile (≤900px) keeps vertical stack via the base `flex-direction: column` from adventure-play.css.
  - **Choice hover root cause + fix**: adventure-play.css:324 sets `background: rgba(accent, 0.1)` on hover, which clobbered the `--sf-bg-caption` base while leaving paper-tile + multiply blend in place — multiply over faint accent tint = dark mush. Override in PR8 block restores `--sf-bg-caption-alt` on hover; lift via `translateY(-3px)` + 1px solid orange ring.
  - **Turn counter** `#turnLabel` + `#turnMax` promoted to Bangers display font, `0.95rem`, `--sf-text-primary` cream (was inheriting 12px muted-grey from the bar).
  - **Turn bar** horizontal padding `0` → `0.85rem` so "Turn 1" / audio controls aren't flush to the bar edges.
  - **Location badge moved** from between turn bar and story title (a confusing middle spot) to between scene image and turn bar. `align-self: flex-start` keeps it left-aligned to the image edge like a Tintin panel pin. `margin: -0.25rem 0 0 0` resets the negative bottom margin from the old position.

  **Sidebar polish** (the original spec):
  - Section headers, "THE DOSSIER" pseudo-header (`.adv-sidebar::before` at theme.css:1759 — easy to miss because it's CSS-only), level badge → `--sf-accent-chrome` (warm regardless of genre).
  - HP bar default `.adv-hp__fill` was painted ember red regardless of percentage at theme.css:1508. Override sequence in PR8 block: default `--sf-status-good` (forest green), `--warning` → gold, `--danger` → ember red. Theme override now correctly state-aware.
  - Sidebar portrait 48px circle → 60px square + 6px radius + 2px black border. State already wired via `gameState.portraitImage` in `renderSidebarPortrait()` — no flag-back needed.
  - Pause button → warm orange chrome pill (Bangers, 2px radius). Fullscreen + Undo icon buttons → cream pill matching nav. Pause is the only orange item in the nav — signals "session state action" vs navigation.

  **Inventory dropdown — cream paper card** (was navy `rgba(15, 15, 35, 0.6)` from adventure-play.css:670, legacy SaaS palette):
  - `.adv-inventory__detail` → cream `--sf-bg-caption` + paper-tile multiply, 1px black border, `--sf-ink-secondary` italic desc text.
  - Action buttons (`--equip`/`--unequip`/`--use`/`--drop`) re-tuned for cream surface: stronger borders, more saturated colors (red drop, gold use, green equip) so they read against cream instead of being washed out.

  **Genre palette overhaul** — current pirate orange clashed with brand orange. Cascading rethink:
  | Genre | Old | New |
  |---|---|---|
  | Pirate | `#D96B1A` orange | `#2E7D7A` teal-green (Caribbean / oxidized brass) |
  | Fantasy | `#B8602C` brown-orange | `#6B4F8A` muted violet (wizardry / magic) |
  | Detective | `#C89B3C` gold | `#4A5F3D` forest green (leather chair / study) |
  | Superhero | `#B0392C` muted red | `#3760A8` moody cobalt (comic-noir cape) |
  - Updated in **all three places** for each genre (per skill convention): `adventure-effects.css` accent overrides + `data/genres.json` color field + `adventure-play.css` scene-wrap loading gradient.
  - Soft variants (`--sf-accent-soft`) follow the existing pattern — ~30% lighter, slightly more saturated.
  - Composition shift: was "warm-family except sci-fi", now mostly cool/varied genres with the constant warm `--sf-accent-chrome` (`#EF8A1F`) anchoring brand identity. Each genre = clear "mode indicator", none echoes the brand orange.
  - Unchanged: Horror `#C83A2E` blood red, Sci-Fi `#4A6B7C` muted steel, Post-Apoc `#8B4A2B` burnt earth.

  **Misc:**
  - `.adv-scene__text:empty { display: none }` so the cream caption box doesn't render as a leftover empty rectangle below the audio bar before the scene text arrives. Stripped the placeholder HTML comment in [play.html](../../../ambientpixels/storyforge/play.html) that defeated the `:empty` match.
  - **Cache version**: bumped letter-by-letter through the session (a → r). Final: `?v=20260425r`.

## File Map

### Pages
- `storyforge/index.html` — Hub (landing page)
- `storyforge/play.html` — Play (wizard + gameplay) — **main page**
- `storyforge/gallery.html` — Gallery (shared adventures)

### JavaScript (in `storyforge/js/`)
| File | Lines | Role |
|------|-------|------|
| `adventure-engine.js` | 2,787 | **Core** — wizard, turns, scene render, choices, dice, bottom sheet, save/load |
| `adventure-ai.js` | 815 | Gemini API — story gen, image gen, portrait gen, TTS |
| `adventure-rpg.js` | 407 | Stats, XP, leveling, inventory, companions, combat |
| `adventure-audio.js` | 320 | Ambient music + SFX playback |
| `adventure-gallery.js` | 530 | Gallery cards, filters, detail view |
| `adventure-app.js` | 239 | Hub page logic |
| `adventure-entitlements.js` | 204 | Pro/free tier, daily limits, Stripe |
| `adventure-ui.js` | 189 | Shared utils: `$()`, `escapeHtml()`, toasts |
| `adventure-storage.js` | 166 | LocalStorage + server save/load |
| `adventure-tutorial.js` | 185 | First-run tutorial overlay |
| `adventure-share.js` | 59 | Share URL + clipboard |

Scripts load with `defer` in this order: audio → ui → rpg → storage → share → ai → entitlements → engine → tutorial. Each module exposes a global (`UI`, `AI`, `Ent`, `RPG`, `Audio`, `Storage`, `Share`) on `window`.

### CSS (in `storyforge/css/`)
| File | Lines | Scope |
|------|-------|-------|
| `adventure-base.css` | 417 | Design tokens (`--sf-*`), layout, header, buttons. **Fallback only since 2026-04-24** — values are overridden by `adventure-theme.css`. |
| `adventure-theme.css` | ~3,000 | **Design system** — warm-orange/cream graphic-novel theme. Re-declares `--sf-*` tokens at `:root`, adds `@font-face`, all comic-panel styling. Loads AFTER `adventure-base.css`, BEFORE `adventure-responsive.css`. **Append-only — earlier rules lose to later rules in the same file.** |
| `adventure-play.css` | 2,757 | Play screen (scene, choices, sidebar, dice, ending) |
| `adventure-responsive.css` | 471 | Mobile breakpoints (900/768/600/480px) — **loads last** |
| `adventure-particles.css` | 1,616 | Genre particle animations |
| `adventure-gallery.css` | 787 | Gallery grid + cards |

## Critical Rules

### Cache busting
Azure SWA serves CSS/JS with a 7-day immutable CDN cache (`Cache-Control: max-age=604800, immutable`). Without cache-busting params, users won't see your changes for up to a week — even after a successful deploy. All `<link>` and `<script>` tags use `?v=YYYYMMDD[letter]` params. When you change any CSS or JS file, bump the version in **all three HTML pages** (play.html, index.html, gallery.html) in the same commit. This was a painful lesson — partial cache busting causes confusing inconsistencies.

Current: `?v=20260424n`

### CSS cascade
`adventure-responsive.css` loads last in the stylesheet chain. Because of CSS specificity rules, a bare selector later in the cascade beats an identical selector inside an earlier `@media` block. This means desktop-only hiding rules (like hiding the mobile bottom sheet handle) must be wrapped in `@media(min-width: 901px)` — a bare `display: none` will override the mobile `display: flex` and silently break mobile layouts.

### Design tokens
All colors come from `--sf-*` custom properties defined in `adventure-base.css :root`. Use these instead of raw hex/rgba values so the design stays consistent and themeable. Key tokens: `--sf-accent`, `--sf-bg-deep/surface/elevated`, `--sf-text/text-muted/text-dim`, `--sf-success/danger/warning/info`.

### Mobile bottom sheet
On screens narrower than 900px, the desktop sidebar becomes a fixed bottom sheet. Understanding this pattern prevents layout bugs on mobile:
- Collapsed: 110px tall showing drag handle + mini stats bar (HP/Turn/Gold)
- Handle + mini bar are injected by JS (`initBottomSheet()` in engine.js ~line 2737)
- Handle visibility is CSS-controlled: `display: flex` in `@media(max-width:900px)`, `display: none` in `@media(min-width:901px)`
- Tap or swipe expands to 70vh with all stat panels visible

### Responsive breakpoints
- **900px**: Column layout, sidebar → bottom sheet, hide immersive button
- **768px**: Wizard stats stack vertically
- **600px**: 2-col genre grid, hide wizard step labels, smaller text
- **480px**: Hide logo text, compact header, wrap audio controls, hide choice keys

These files are large and interconnected — read them fully before editing, and keep changes minimal and focused:
- `adventure-engine.js` — orchestrates everything (2,787 lines)
- `adventure-theme.css` — design system, ~3,000 lines. Cascade-ordered: append new overrides at the END so they win.

## Design System Conventions (post 2026-04-24 overhaul)

**Token redirection, not renaming.** The new theme reuses the existing 590+ `--sf-*` token references but redirects their values to the warm palette via `adventure-theme.css :root`. Don't rename `--sf-bg-deep` to `--sf-bg-page` etc — the bridge mappings in adventure-theme.css already handle it.

**Border vs page color collision.** `--sf-border-heavy` and `--sf-bg-page` are both `#1A1410`. Borders using the token on a dark-page surface are invisible. Use literal `#000` for hero panel border, scene image-wrap, etc. when the surface IS the dark page.

**Cream-mode panels.** Wizard steps 2 + 3 use cream paper-textured surface (`var(--sf-bg-caption)` + `paper-tile.png` multiply-blend) at desktop only. Mobile (≤900px) falls back to dark `var(--sf-bg-panel)` because paper-tile reads as washed out at small sizes.

**Hand-drawn SVG borders.** Three places use the inline-SVG `feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap` rect-stroke pattern: hero panel `::before`, caption box `::before`, CTA button `::before`. Each has its own random `seed` so they don't look identical. Tunable params: `inset`, `stroke-width`, displacement `scale`, frequency `baseFrequency`. Genre rail frame border was attempted as bitmap (`images/assets/genre-frame.png`) but reverted — currently no frame around the rail.

**Class naming kept legacy.** `.adv-*` BEM convention preserved. The user-supplied design spec used `.sf-*` names but renaming 590+ refs was rejected as too risky. New CSS uses `.adv-*` to match.

**Choice card horizontal layout.** Active story choice cards are `grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr)` on desktop with display-font "CHOICE 1/2/3" tab labels (CSS `::before` prepends "CHOICE " to the JS-rendered digit).
